name: speakers_get_appearances
title: Get where a person appears
description: Reads a person's current Recording voices, saved answers with lost placement, and editorial Moments. Each voice carries its current identity state, source timing when available, and the recording_id/speaker_map_id selector for recordings_get_speaker_evidence. Unplaced answers retain their recording_id/decision_id selector when available; no current occurrence or timing is inferred. Sightings are faces currently named as this person, each with its image_answer_id or automatic basis and source seconds. Each recent group reports truncation separately. A suggestion is not an attached person. With project_id, all rows are project-scoped and assignment exceptions are reported separately. Moment rows keep the transcript speaker_label and use current project presentation for display_label. Legacy clips and exports groups are empty; exact finished Export labels are not recalculated.

speaker_profile_id.description: Person public ID, slug, or UUID.

status.description: Optional Moment status filter. Defaults to all. Voices always describe current placements; their standing reports any stale review separately.

project_id.description: Optional project public ID to limit results.

limit.description: Maximum rows per group. Default 20, maximum 50.

cursor.description: Optional next_cursor from a previous call, to read the next page of voices, saved answers and sightings.
